extracted.name: Mega Italian Salad
extracted.description: My favourite big Italian salad. The homemade dressing is seriously tasty! The croutons and dusting of parmesan is the perfect finishing touch that everybody loves. Serve with pasta, a cosy lasagne or big tray of cannelloni. Lots of suggestions in the post!{No video today because I thought this was quite straight forward. But if you want one, leave me a message below!}
ingredient_lines: 3 slices white sandwich bread (, ~1.75 cm / 3/4" thick, crust off, cut into cubes (Note 1))
1/4 tsp chilli flakes ((red pepper flakes), optional)
1 head cos / romaine lettuce (, chopped into large or small bite size pieces (Note 3))
2 large tomatoes (, cut into 6 to 8 wedges, then each wedge in half)
instruction_lines: Croutons: Preheat oven to 200°C/390°F (180°C fan). Toss bread with oil and salt. Spread on a tray and bake 15 minutes, stirring twice, until golden and fully crisp. Cool on tray.
Dressing: Shake ingredients in a jar.
Make salad: Set aside some parmesan for garnish. Place croutons and all remaining salad ingredients in a large bowl. Pour Dressing over, toss well.
Serve: Transfer salad into a serving bowl. Sprinkle with reserved parmesan. Serve immediately!
